response.text:
Do this when seeing/encountering a demonic/jinn-like or other hostile or intrusive presence: This is a quick reference to the basics of the triage steps, medical danger, environment, body, overload, and mind opened. Open eyes, make sure of environmental safety, feel connection with body such as feet on floor, reduce environmental stimulation, remove yourself from any hostile environments or people, stop doing anything that would increase stimulation to the mind. Do not attempt to go deeper, to find out more, to be ontological, or do anything to increase destabilization.

Mantra: Only what can be integrated is allowed at this time. If it is too much, it can wait. The adult self is always available to be there. Return the body to a safe place.

If at any time during self-hypnosis sessions, if there is danger to yourself or others, if things become too scary and psychosis-like, if unable to sleep, if feeling extremely paranoid, if experiencing chest pain, seizures, serious overheating, drug or other substance overdose, or inability to function, the session is over, and help should be sought in the real world.
